about.metaDescription: Orca-Tech is an engineering studio in Dubai. We partner with companies to design, build, and operate software that compounds.
about.heroTitle: Built for teams who take software seriously.
about.heroSubtitle: Orca-Tech is an engineering studio and software house. We help organizations ship products that feel inevitable — precise, resilient, and ready to scale.
about.storyBody: We started Orca-Tech because too many digital programs stall between a beautiful deck and a production system. Our model is simple: senior craft, clear ownership, and delivery that survives contact with the real world.
about.missionBody: Turn ambitious product ideas into durable software — with the discipline of an engineering firm and the taste of a design studio.
about.visionBody: To be the partner companies call when the work has to be excellent, the stack has to last, and the team has to move without drama.

q1.a: A short discovery call, then a scoped proposal with timeline, team shape, and commercial model. We do not start building until the outcome is explicit.

q2.q: Do you work with in-house teams?
q2.a: Yes. Many clients embed us as a product pod — we complement internal engineering rather than replace it.

q3.a: A focused MVP is often 8–14 weeks. Platform and commerce programs run longer, in milestone releases.

q4.q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
q4.a: We regularly audit, stabilize, and extend inherited systems. We will tell you honestly if a rewrite is the cheaper path.
